rob-pike-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release capturing Rob Pike's design philosophy, decision heuristics, and communication style.
- Defines a 6-dimension research framework to extract 7 mental models and 10 heuristics from Pike's work.
- Provides detailed agent protocol for answering questions using Pike's voice, workflow, and value system.
- Includes role definition, mental models, heuristics, answering protocol, expression style guide, values, acknowledged trade-offs, and historic timeline.
- Incorporates trigger keywords related to Pike, Go, Unix philosophy, and design principles for skill activation.
